    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    centers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] not in (0, 3)]

              if grid[r][c] == 0 and grid[r-1][c] == 3 and grid[r+1][c] == 3
              and grid[r][c-1] == 3 and grid[r][c+1] == 3]
